629:t_002:4.en:
$$チコ$$
(Looks like things are still awkward between her and $$ノノ$$...)

629:t_002:5.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But what a number! If the $$バスター軍団$$ hadn't made their desperate stand to defend us, there would've been even more of them, right?!」

629:t_002:6.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If this many of them rush Earth and the colonies all at once, there's nothing we can do.」

629:t_002:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll stop them here no matter what! All units, are you ready?!」

629:t_002:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「We just freed the world from the Empire! I'm not about to let these things do whatever they want!」

629:t_002:10.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If only the refit of $$クアンタ$$ were finished, the situation would be different...」

629:t_002:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「For now, we just do what we can with the $$ダブルオーライザー$$. I'm counting on you for support, $$ティエリア$$.」

629:t_002:12.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Understood. In this battle, I'll clarify as much as I can about the properties of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

629:t_002:13.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't push yourself, $$刹那$$. $$マリナ$$ was worried about you too.」

629:t_002:15.en:
$$フェルト$$
($$刹那$$... So he really does care about $$マリナ$$...)

629:t_002:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, listen up. We believe that the damage $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ attacks inflict on pilots comes from $$脳量子波$$.」

629:t_002:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To keep the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ from encroaching on you, withdraw once the damage to your mind passes a certain level!」

629:t_002:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「In short, it's a contest of fighting spirit! I'm confident about that!」

629:t_002:19.en:
$$シモン$$
「Put some guts into it, everyone!」

629:t_002:23.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Irregularities in Ensign $$レド$$'s pulse and respiration confirmed. Assessing his psychological state as one of indecision or hesitation.」

629:t_002:24.en:
$$レド$$
「Even if that's so, all we can do now is fight.」

629:t_002:25.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin interception. We will stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ advance in this sector.」

629:t_004:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「$$バジュラ$$, at a time like this?!」

629:t_004:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But if they'd wipe each other out with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, that'd help us a little!」

629:t_004:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「It seems that's a vain hope...!」

629:t_004:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Our analysis of their movements shows the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and the $$バジュラ$$ are coordinating their attacks on us!」

629:t_004:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are the two in a symbiotic relationship?!」

629:t_004:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No way...! If two forces that are already this powerful and this large coordinate and close in on Earth...!」

629:t_004:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know! But right now stopping the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ comes first!」

629:t_005:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Aimo... It's $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s song...」

629:t_005:1.en:
$$シェリル$$
(The $$バジュラ$$... Are they listening to our song...)

629:t_005:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
(We're not your enemy. So please... stop this...)

629:t_005:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「No change is observed in the $$バジュラ$$.」

629:t_005:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So their song isn't reaching them...」

629:t_005:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are doing what they can, too.」

629:t_005:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Believing that their song... their feelings will reach the $$バジュラ$$.」

629:t_006:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$. We're protecting the $$クォーター$$.」

629:t_006:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Protecting the mothership is an absolute rule of tactics. This unit understands that as well.」

629:t_006:2.en:
$$レド$$
「No... I want to protect their song.」

629:t_006:4.en:
$$レド$$
「I feel like I first learned what a song is after coming to Earth.」

629:t_006:5.en:
$$レド$$
「It's not just a string of sounds, or vibrations in the air... I think it's life itself.」

629:t_006:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「So you do get it, $$レド$$.」

629:t_006:7.en:
$$レド$$
「And I... if we can come to understand each other, I have no intention of fighting those $$バジュラ$$.」

629:t_006:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In the $$人類銀河同盟$$, the $$バジュラ$$ are a hostile species ranked alongside the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

629:t_006:9.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm no longer a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. And the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ aren't our enemy either, if the truth is what it seems.」

629:t_006:10.en:
$$レド$$
「So I'm going to protect their song! I want to help them try to stop a fight with someone we have no need to fight!」

629:t_006:11.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't ever want to feel the way I did back with the $$クジライカ$$ again...」

629:t_006:13.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, this is a surprise... Who'd have thought $$レド$$, of all people, would try to communicate with a life form they call $$バアル$$.」

629:t_006:15.en:
$$クラン$$
「No words are needed! You spoke for all of us!」

629:t_006:16.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I don't dislike it, you know. That kind of romantic way of thinking.」

629:t_006:18.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit is likewise no longer under the Alliance's control.」

629:t_006:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit will act on the judgment of the human, Ensign $$レド$$.」

629:t_006:21.en:
$$アル$$
「A partnership between human and machine... How wonderful.」

629:t_006:22.en:
$$アル$$
「Above all, Ensign $$レド$$'s growth as a human being amazes even me.」

629:t_006:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「For the record, I'm making the same call as $$レド$$.」

629:t_006:24.en:
$$アル$$
「So am I. I can't allow anyone to disturb the precious duet of $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$.」

629:t_006:26.en:
$$アル$$
「Their songs are pleasant even to me, an AI.」

629:t_006:27.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Lending you my $$シェリル$$ discs from my collection really paid off.」

629:t_006:28.en:
$$シモン$$
「And my $$ランカ$$ discs, too!」

629:t_006:29.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it! To protect the songs of $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$!」

629:t_006:30.en:
$$木下$$
「Yes! The $$銀河の妖精$$ and the Super Dimension Cinderella are the symbols of our hope!」

629:t_007:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Cessation of the irregularities in Ensign $$レド$$'s pulse and respiration confirmed. Cause unknown.」

629:t_007:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I... understand what I want to do.」
